name: Ki ni Naru Ano Ko ni Hamster o Fukyoushitai!!
original_name: 気になるあの子にハムスターを布教したい！！
source:
Kimitaka, an office worker who loves hamsters, meets a man named Yon, who claims to be a scientist. Yon researches small animals, but apparently knows nothing about hamsters!?
What will await them at the end of this otherworldly exchange, connected by their love of hamsters...?

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/kiniham.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
热爱仓鼠的上班族公贵，结识了一名自称科学家的男子“尤恩”。尤恩虽然专门研究小型动物，却似乎对仓鼠一无所知！？
这场因仓鼠之爱而结缘的跨界交流，最终将为两人带来怎样的结局……？

[译自[url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/kiniham.html]官方网站[/url]]
